## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2022-08-15: SPAC business combination between Founder SPAC and Rubicon Technologies, LLC closes; TRA executed between Rubicon Technologies, Inc., Rubicon Technologies Holdings LLC, and the TRA Holders (Unblocked holders of Class B Units plus Blocked Unitholders), paying 85% of Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit on Section 754 basis step-ups, NOLs acquired in Blocker Mergers, and imputed-interest deductions
- 2022-08-19: 8-K files the executed TRA as exhibit 10.10

#### Deregistration

- 2024-12-03: Securities Purchase Agreement with MBI Holdings, LP for Series B Convertible Preferred Stock (per December 6, 2024 8-K)
- 2025-01-22: Form 15-12G filed deregistering Class A common stock under Section 12(g) (per SEC metadata, outside this directory)

## Explanation

Rubicon Technologies' August 15, 2022 SPAC business combination (Founder SPAC acquiring Rubicon Technologies, LLC) created a TRA paying 85% of Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit to the Continuing LLC Members and Blocked Unitholders, covering Section 754 basis step-ups on exchanges of Class B Units, NOLs acquired in the Blocker Mergers, and imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments. No amendments or terminations were filed during the firm's public life. No TRA liability was ever recognized: the Company carried a full valuation allowance against the underlying deferred tax assets throughout the contract's life, and the FY2023 10-K illustrated the magnitude only hypothetically (about $335.5M of undiscounted 85% payments if all Class B Units were exchanged at $10/share). Rubicon filed Form 15-12G on January 22, 2025 (per SEC metadata, after this directory's coverage), deregistering its Class A common stock; the TRA's post-deregistration fate cannot be determined from EDGAR because deregistration by itself does not terminate the contract and no extrinsic-event filing is visible. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the coverage-gap list of post-December-2024 filings to retrieve in a future run.
